name: Shop Lease by Date
query:
SELECT
    `tabAirport Shop`.name AS "Shop:Link/Airport Shop:120",
    IFNULL(`tabShop Rental Contract`.tenant, 'No Contract') AS "Tenant:Text:150",
    `tabShop Rental Contract`.effective_date AS "Effective Date:Date:120",
    `tabShop Rental Contract`.expiry_date AS "Expiry Date:Date:120",
    `tabShop Rental Contract`.docstatus AS "DocStatus:Int:100",
    `tabShop Rental Contract`.name AS "Contract:Link/Shop Rental Contract:180"
FROM 
    `tabAirport Shop`
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabShop Rental Contract` ON `tabShop Rental Contract`.airport_shop = `tabAirport Shop`.name
WHERE
    `tabAirport Shop`.name = %(airport_shop)s
ORDER BY 
    `tabAirport Shop`.name ASC, 
    `tabShop Rental Contract`.expiry_date ASC
